title: auth/reader: duplicate bcrypt hash validation logic not consolidated into auth crate
description: After the CredentialStore merge, bcrypt hash validation is still split: parse_bcrypt_cost() is private in crates/auth/src/store.rs, and looks_like_bcrypt_hash() is public in crates/reader/src/config.rs. Both validate the same domain (bcrypt hash format, cost range 4-31) with slightly different logic (looks_like_bcrypt_hash additionally checks s.len()>=60). The reader crate should import a public validator from stoa_auth instead of maintaining its own.
notes: Fix: expose parse_bcrypt_cost or a combined looks_like_bcrypt_hash from crates/auth/src/store.rs (or a new crates/auth/src/validate.rs). Replace crates/reader/src/config.rs looks_like_bcrypt_hash with pub use stoa_auth::looks_like_bcrypt_hash. The two implementations differ: add the length check to the auth crate version when consolidating.
